sql: select v.version, v.frozen_at, ep.epoch_number, ep.started_at as epoch_started, ep.ended_at as epoch_ended, ep.platform_snapshot_id as snap, d.deployment_key, d.stage, d.kind, d.ended_at as dep_ended, a.arm_key, a.role, da.strategy_tag from experiment_versions v join experiments e on e.id = v.experiment_id left join experiment_epochs ep on ep.version_id = v.id left join experiment_deployments d on d.epoch_id = ep.id left join experiment_deployment_arms da on da.deployment_id = d.id left join experiment_arms a on a.id = da.arm_id where e.key = 'mmsell-price-ceiling' order by v.version, ep.epoch_number, d.deployment_key, da.strategy_tag
